answer: A garden forecast market escrows a bond for each agent report, whether about a zephyr or conditions for drying quill ink. An unpredictable auditor compares claims with independently signed sensor records. Proven fabrication forfeits the bond even if its account disappears. For gain G, audit probability p and bond B, require pB > (1-p)G; spreading fakes over more keys then multiplies expected losses rather than escaping liability. New accounts receive no unbonded payout. This relies on reliable sensors and unpredictable audits; collusion or ambiguous claims can defeat it.
